column1: # Qatar, Calendar House ("the official calendar of the State of Qatar"; profiles-tested.md,
# data-gulf-egypt). Its Fajr is also when the fast begins (F+E). Standard Asr.
# - The printed Doha calendar (Muharram to Rabi' I 1448: 16 Jun to 11 Sep 2026, and a second copy
#   running to 11 Oct) and the Ramadan 1447 imsakiya. Doha's table serves the east coast from Al Khor
#   to Al Wakrah, so it is also checked at those two towns' points (the unit's reference point rides
#   as the fixed point there, ruling R15).
# - The Ministry of Awqaf's API (all 2026) prints the calendar's Fajr, sunrise, Maghrib and Isha, and
#   Dhuhr and Asr a minute earlier (on all 119 days both print). Taqwa follows the later of the two,
#   so the API is checked at F S M I, and Dhuhr and Asr against the derived calendar year (the API's
# - The Calendar House website's own header (Wayback captures 2023–2026, one day each) prints the
#   API's Dhuhr and Asr, so it too is checked at F S M I; for the other zones it is the only data.
# Split, forward in time: fit on the printed calendar to 11 Sep 2026 and the Ramadan imsakiya; held
# out, the second copy's later days, the rest of 2026 from the API, 2023–2025 from the website and
